name: Members Only: Palm Beach
summary: Private clubs, luxurious couture and charity galas mean everything in this soapy reality series, set in a posh paradise with a wealth of drama.

name: Шальной отдел
summary:
Kirill Shaloy lives and acts in full accordance with his surname, which he was given in the orphanage. This helps him and hinders him at the same time. 

Kirill joined the police and rose to the position of deputy head of the criminal investigation department of one of the central departments of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. But when his wife, Elizabeth, the first beauty of the department, began to be importunately courted by the head of the department, Crazy, unable to bear the blow to his ego, punched him in the face, for which he was transferred to the service in a residential area, where he headed the operational department. 

Under the leadership of Shaly, there are several operas, which, for various reasons, are not so easy to organize. And especially for a man like Kirill Shaloy. After all, he's used to being responsible only for himself.

name: Darwin Jihen
summary: The Animal Liberation Alliance, an eco-terrorist organization, rescues a pregnant chimpanzee from an animal testing lab—only for it to give birth to a half-human, half-chimpanzee "humanzee" named Charlie! Fifteen years later, Charlie's human foster parents are finally ready to send him to a normal high school, where he makes his first friend: a human girl named Lucy. In the meantime, however, the ALA's stance has become ever more extreme, and now they're here to drag Charlie into their terrorist plot...

name: Dark Moon: The Blood Altar
summary: In the seaside city of Riverfield stands Decelis Academy, home to seven mysterious boys sharing the same secret: They're vampires, hiding their murky pasts. When Sooha, a female student who hates vampires, transfers to the academy, the boys find themselves irresistibly drawn to her. As strange events shake the city, old sins and buried secrets resurface, and their world begins to fracture.

name: Meu Ayrton, por Adriane Galisteu
summary: Brazilian personality Adriane Galisteu relives her love story with F1 driver Ayrton Senna and the controversy she faced following his tragic death.

name: Critical Role Cooldown
summary: Get a backstage pass to a Critical Role episode. You'll be right there at the table immediately after Matt says "Is it Thursday yet?", experiencing the cast's post-show reactions. Share in the tumult of theories, the chaos of questions, and the pitching of plans from the cast after the show. If you've ever wondered what lies just beyond the curtain, this is your chance to find out. Starting with Campaign 3, Episode 83, you'll get instant access to 10 episodes with new episodes dropping every Thursday with each new Critical Role episode.

name: Sign Star
summary: The talent show where three new competing sign language artists meet in each episode - but only one makes it to the final. Who will win the hearts of the jury and become this year's Sign star 2025?

name: Strangers
summary: Anthology series of stand alone episodes about Americans in Paris and the sometimes tragic and sometimes uplifting relationships, trysts and loves they find there.

name: Nya Noa Nyman
summary: The year is 2065 and Noa is given a unique chance to change the life choices he regrets. He travels back to 2025, the week he turned 27, and meets his younger self. A twisted, warm and existentially confused comedy about time paradoxes, decisions, regret, love and the art of coming to terms with oneself.

name: Trigger Point
summary: Trigger Point follows a group of former Tier One Special Forces Operators who sell their elite skills to the criminal underworld behind the front of a private military contracting firm — and the FBI agent who's hunting for them.

name: Shen Qian - Qiang Zhi Dao Dai
Yiya
summary: Based on true events, "Yiya" follows the story of Yiya Murano, Argentina's first female serial killer. Set in the 1970s, the mini-series explores her manipulative schemes and the shocking crimes that made her infamous as the Poisoner of Monserrat, blending drama and crime in a tense investigation.

name: Deal or No Deal
summary: Rickard Sjöberg hosts the exciting quiz show Deal or No Deal, where one contestant takes on the hunt for one million kronor. The twenty contestants in the studio come from all over the country, they have all won their participation and also represent their postcodes. But only one lucky winner gets the chance to choose from the gold bags and win one million kronor.

name: Reencarne
summary: In this supernatural thriller, the dark mysteries of the quest for immortality unfold along the scorching rural roads of the interior of Goiás.

name: The Rise of the Qin Empire
Thinking of You in the Long Night
The Palace Gambit
summary: Two sisters are summoned to the imperial court. The elder is a woman of peerless beauty, the younger a quick-witted charmer. Seeking only a peaceful existence, they instead find themselves the targets of deadly schemes with no escape in sight. Forging an unstoppable alliance, they win the Emperor's favor within months. But at the peak of their glory, the elder sister, carrying the imperial heir, meets a tragic end. Overnight, their favor vanishes. Now, the younger sister, Lu Jiuning, buries her hatred and, from her lowly position as a palace maid, challenges the entire harem. She maneuvers among the consorts and stands firm before the Emperor, setting her meticulous plans for revenge. This battle is not for favor, but for blood!

name: Back to Your Love
summary: At her husband Jiang Yan's funeral, Fang He discovers a hundred love letters he never sent and finally realizes how deeply she wronged his devotion. Overwhelmed with grief, she is unexpectedly reborn three years into the past. In this new life, she takes the initiative to draw closer to Jiang Yan and tries to mend the rift between them. Yet Jiang Yan greets her sudden change with suspicion and guarded distance. Can the two of them break free from fate and walk through this lifetime hand in hand?

name: Love as a Cure
summary: Mo Xiaoxian, a medicine devotee, sets her sights on Crown Prince Qi Jue who suffers from the rare poison "Bai Guanyin." She barges into the Eastern Palace to treat him, helping him uncover the truth that the Empress Dowager is the one who poisoned him. Resolved to seize the throne, Qi Jue strikes a deal with Mo Xiaoxian: he lets her test her medicines on him in exchange for her curing his poison. Amid the whirlpool of royal political intrigue, the two stand firmly by each other, unmasking a web of conspiracies.

name: Da Ye Da Yr Yu You Ai
Ao Bing: A Shadow Puppet's Great Adventure
Secrets of the Royals: Births, Marriages and Deaths
summary: Stunning series telling the story of 1000 years of monarchy via powerful, pivotal moments.

name: Secrets of the Royals
summary: Secrets of the Royals is a light-hearted glimpse into the unique world of the British Royal Family from royal traditions and priceless jewels to healthcare, and a look through the keyhole of the grand palaces. The series will feature fun anecdotes from former butlers, chefs, and other royal workers, as well as contributions from historians and royal correspondents, sharing a different side to the royals, one the public rarely gets to see.

name: Semester Med Garplind
summary: Christopher Garplind's life is a burning hell. He has too much on his plate. That's why he goes on six vacations together with as many famous Swedes as he thinks need a little break. Guests include Ulf Brunnberg, Daniela Rathana, David Lagercrantz, Miriam Bryant and Markus Krunegård.

name: Fiskeracet Genom Tornedalen
summary: In this series we follow young fishing enthusiasts Elin Seger and Lucas Lövgren as they try to catch as many different species as possible during three fishing trips. Whoever manages to catch the most species wins the Fishing Race through Tornedalen.

name: Den Italienska Husdrommen
summary: Bill Nylander and Marie Olsson Nylander are facing their biggest renovation challenge ever - an unlikely renovation project in Sicily. They will buy, renovate and transform a 1-euro house into their dream home.

name: Исходный код
summary:
Source Code is a documentary series about how the past few years have changed the games industry and the people working in it.
The pandemic, the protests, the war — all of it has impacted game development.
Some people lost their jobs, some had to leave their homes, others found in games a way to speak about reality.

At the center of the story are developers from Ukraine, Belarus, and Russia, as well as their colleagues from other countries — speaking about work, burnout, relocation, and about how to keep living when the familiar world begins to fall apart.

name: Doden Liegen Niet
summary: Forensic pathologist Frank van de Goot takes you on a journey through his daily life with death. Driven by curiosity and a passion for his profession, he is always searching for the true cause of death. Through unconventional experiments, he gathers evidence that sheds new light on the cause of death.

name: Shakedown
summary:
Shakedown is the gripping true story of how a group of ordinary Australians risked it all to expose an unlawful automated debt-recovery system that falsely accused half a million people of welfare fraud.

This searing drama is set to reveal how a courageous coalition of victims, activists, journalists, and lawyers fought back against a government and bureaucracy that refused to listen - uncovering what's been described as Australia's greatest miscarriage of justice.

name: Ground Up
summary:
Set in Tasmania, the series follows AFL administrator Hugh Shen, dispatched from Melbourne to establish the island's first-ever AFL team. But there's a catch: the locals must build a brand-new stadium and not everyone's happy about the $1.13 billion taxpayer-funded spend. 

Hugh's mission? Win over a divided public, meet impossible deadlines, placate feisty protesters, and somehow find a coach, players, and a mascot that won't offend anyone. Should be a piece of cake.

name: Shaun Micallef's Going For Broke
summary:
In Shaun Micallef's Going For Broke, the famous writer, actor and comedian taps back into his curious side and sets out to understand a national obsession he's never quite grasped.

Shaun has never understood gambling. He uses cold, hard logic when making decisions and always plays for certainty. But as viewers saw in On The Sauce, even a teetotaller can be swayed - Shaun spent one episode getting drunk to better understand Australia's relationship with alcohol.

Now, he turns a sober eye to our love affair with gambling. Travelling across the country, Shaun meets punters, experts, and those affected by the industry to uncover how Australia became the biggest gambling nation in the world. From pokies in suburban pubs to high-stakes sports betting, Going For Broke asks: are we making a risky bet on our future?

Can even Shaun's rational mind resist the lure of a "sure thing"?

name: The Moon Rises Above the Sea
Born To Be The Villain
summary: Lu Chengwen unexpectedly finds himself trapped inside a novel, cast as the villain destined for a brutal death. His only strategy is to lie low and survive at all costs. But when the heroines begin awakening to a power that lets them hear his thoughts, the story spirals out of control. In the end, he must join forces with the novel's awakened hero, Gu Zhantian, to challenge the very forces manipulating their fate, and in doing so, discover a path to both redemption and a way home.

name: Phoenix's Homecoming
summary: Once the most powerful princess in the realm, she was betrayed by her beloved tutor and her own imperial brother, and perished in flames. Reborn from the ashes, she now sees her former white moonlight, the revered tutor, bowing at her feet, while the prince of a rival nation serves as her hidden blade. Though the Empress sees her as a destined rival, what she intends to reclaim is far more than the throne! If love was once her chessboard, now power is her game. In the raging tide of love and vengeance, a crown awaits its true sovereign.

name: Bloom in Turmoil
summary: Betrayed by those she trusted most, Lu Xinnian transforms from a fragile heiress into a formidable warrior goddess. Tearing through labels in a whirlwind of love, betrayal, and power struggles with her lover, she joins forces with the "Sisters of Bloom" to embark on an epic, passion-fueled legend in ancient times!

name: Marry Him in Her Place
summary: On her wedding night, wealthy heiress Liang Yi is disfigured and thrown into the river by her husband Song Zhichu. Unexpectedly rescued, she is forced to take on a new face and live as Xu Yin, a courtesan. "The best mask in this world is another living face." Thus reborn, she uses Xu Yin's identity to get close to gang leader Lin Yun, setting off on her path of revenge.

name: The Big Pet Project
summary:
Ireland's most extraordinary pets will be showcased in The Big Pet Project - Saturdays on RTÉ One at 5.15pm and streaming now on RTÉ Player.

From surfing dogs to painting ponies and goal-scoring turtles, The Big Pet Project is crammed full of the weirdest, wackiest and most talented pets and animals. Pet lovers Demi Oviawe and Adam Beales jump in their Pet Mobile and travel across Ireland to meet the nation's most pet-obsessed people and learn all about their pets.

We meet more than 70 animals including axolotls in Belfast, turtles in Tipperary, hawks in Wicklow, pygmy goats in Donegal, a giant millipede in Galway and a massive pig in Dublin! So, if you love pets and animals jump into the chaos because this is the show for you!

name: DJ Carey - The Dodger
summary: Charting a Shakespearean fall from grace of epic proportions that left a generation of hurling fans, and an unknown number of victims, reeling.

name: Neven's Christmas in Limerick
summary: Neven explores the food and culture of this historic city and prepares some of his own favourite recipes for Christmas.

name: Arafta
summary: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart. Suspended between love's salvation and fate's cruelty, Arafta is a saga of passion and payback, where every choice risks turning fire into ashes.

name: I am Boxer
summary: From 30-year boxing veteran Don Lee comes the ultimate survival competition. Ninety boxers, regardless of age, weight, or profession, gather to prove they're the best. They'll face off in explosive matches and missions on an epic scale. Who will survive to the end and be crowned the champion?

name: Baddies USA
summary: OG's hit the road across the USA with packed concerts, camaraderie and chaos.

nextepisode.name: Baddies USA Chapter Two - Reunion, Part 1

name: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win
summary: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win, the latest installment in ESPN's 30 for 30 series, unravels how Berlusconi transformed A.C. Milan into a global powerhouse and used the club's success as a springboard to political dominance. Told over three parts, the film traces his rise from real estate and television to football glory and ultimately to the highest office in Italy. Directed by Sam Blair and produced by Box to Box Films, the documentary captures the interplay of sport, culture and politics at a defining moment in history.

name: Porta premium
summary:
The consultants at the country's largest real estate agency reveal the secrets of their success, convinced that a documentary is being made about their incredible work.
But the filmmaker has other intentions.

name: Kiss Kiss Sxx
summary: Each work differs in tone, style and relationships, but the eight stories, each with a completely different worldview, will be completed as a single omnibus drama.

name: The Man in the Mask: An Orkney Murder
summary: Full of jaw-dropping twists, this is the extraordinary story of the first murder in Orkney for 25 years as the police suspect a schoolboy of shooting dead a waiter in a restaurant.

name: The Noble
summary: The Noble tells the story of Chen Que'er, a maid born into servitude, who uses a magnificent gown to defy fate and change her destiny.With her intelligence and courage, she breaks through every obstacle and stirs up a storm that shakes the world.

name: Angry Wind
summary: Betrayed and cast back in time to 1990, young CEO Zheng Nanfeng finds himself stripped of his title, now managing a dance hall and serving as an aide to his own wife, Zhou Zhiyi. In this era of both innocence and upheaval, he must use his foresight to turn foes into allies and thwart a smuggling ring. More profoundly, through this second chance at life and love beside his formidable wife, he discovers what truly matters. Together, they forge a legendary partnership, standing side-by-side in a tale of strength and redemption.

name: The Ultimate Vow, Unknown to You
summary: Shen Qingru's entire family is massacred. Believing Yuwen Que to be responsible, she sets out on a path of revenge. She marries into the General's household, is later confined within the palace, and becomes entangled with Yuwen Que in a tormenting cycle of love and hatred. When the truth finally comes to light, Yuwen Que is willing to sacrifice everything to protect her. The two reconcile, and Shen Qingru is restored to her true identity as the Princess of Cangzhou. Amid fierce power struggles, both ultimately find redemption.

name: The Inescapable
summary: Hidden deep within a forest of toxic miasma, Baixiao Manor has remained an enigmatic forbidden zone for decades. On the eve of the manor's legendary nocturnal feast, the lord vanishes without a trace. Enter Ye Li, a condemned prisoner who volunteers to investigate, joining forces with Hua Qiankun, a catcher from the Supreme Court. As they step into the heart of the mystery, they unwittingly unravel a conspiracy that threatens to eclipse the very heavens...

name: United FC
summary:
It's time to cheer on your new favourite team - United FC. Get to know the squad in the feel-good teen docuseries that will have you kicking every ball and kick-starting crucial conversations across Ireland.

The new series is presented by Jordan Conroy, two-time Olympian and Irish Rugby Sevens legend along with footballer, presenter and content creator Vanessa Ogbonna - did we mention she won The Traitors Ireland too?!

United FC brings together 15 teenagers from diverse Irish backgrounds for the ultimate team challenge. Part coming-of-age story, part football camp, this thought-provoking series follows these teens as they meet, train and form lasting bonds in the run-up to a soccer tournament. It's not just about goals, it's about identity, resilience, inclusivity and the shared experience of growing up in Ireland today.

Everything builds up to a big tournament, and for the big blitz we called in some extra help from Shamrock Rovers and Cape Verde defender Roberto 'Pico' Lopes and Girls in Green legend Áine O'Gorman. What will the pros think of the United FC squad?

name: Highclere: Behind Closed Doors
summary: Highclere: Behind Closed Doors provides viewers with a unique insight into the lives of Lord and Lady Carnarvon, who manage the estate, and their dedicated staff. The series captures the challenges and triumphs they face in maintaining the historic castle while also preparing for various events and attracting visitors.

name: Gimme Sugar
summary: Gimme Sugar is a reality show that follows Charlene Borja as she attempts to launch LGBT ladies club nights, showing the entire process as she mixes business with pleasure. In the first season, Charlene and four of her friends -- frequent party girls but newbie promoters -- start the Truck Stop in Los Angeles. In season 2, Charlene and Davonee relocate to Miami to start a new event in South Beach, which proves more challenging since the scene caters to a tourist crowd.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: El amor verdadero es eterno

name: Jiu Yang Wushen
summary: Once betrayed and killed at the peak of his power, Ye Yunfei is reborn into his younger self—the moment his martial veins were first destroyed. With all the memories of his past life, he seizes this second chance to protect his loved ones, outmaneuver rival clans and sects, and rebuild his strength.

name: The Golden Egg
summary: After a sudden transfer to the department she dreaded most, Hinako hunts for tabloid scoops at a weekly magazine and searches for meaning in her work.

name: Les saisons
summary: 30 years of a love chase between Camille, Alexandre and Martin, teenage friends, becoming over the decades husband, wife and lover, with, as the center of gravity of these sentimental tears, an old family home in Les Sables d'Olonne, motionless witness of the joys and sorrows of these restless hearts.

name: Kasaba
summary: Selim is strapped for cash. Efe would do anything to help him. When they find a trunkful of stolen money, it becomes a moral dilemma neither want to face.

name: Far Cry
summary: The limited series from Executive Producers Noah Hawley and Rob Mac, with Mac set in the starring role, is based on Ubisoft's global hit video game franchise of the same title and the series will retain Far Cry's signature standalone storytelling format, with each season set in a new setting following a new cast of characters.

name: Gone
summary:
Set against the backdrop of a prestigious private school, a foreboding forest and the quiet sprawl of Bristol, Gone, is a chilling mystery focusing on local Headmaster Michael Polly who becomes the prime suspect in his wife Sarah's disappearance.

An upstanding member of the community, Michael Polly is inscrutable and likes order and precision in his working life. Until, that is, he encounters super bright, gutsy Detective Annie Cassidy and a compulsive game of cat and mouse begins as she chips away at his veneer in search of the truth.

name: The Unseen
summary: While investigating her sister's alleged suicide, blogger Shen Man plunges into a bizarre case involving obstetrician Ai Xia's hysterectomy and becomes the prime suspect. Female police officer Jiang Li helps clear her name. A single postcard, linking the two cases, forces these two opposing women to join forces. However, a second murder swiftly follows, thickening the fog of mystery...

name: Echoes of Love
summary: Modern beauty blogger Song Zhiyun unexpectedly crosses over and becomes Liu Ruyan, a Song Dynasty courtesan. She finds herself caught up in a shocking conspiracy. To uncover the truth, she goes undercover at Huanyue Pavilion and joins forces with a calculating young lord, uncovering a shocking secret along the way!

name: High & Low Born to be High
Executor Across Worlds
summary: Travel through different worlds, crush the villains and rewrite fate! Ace executor Su Luxia is here ,her comeback starts now!

name: The Spooky Love Tale
summary: Ghosts aren't real... right? Chan has a wild imagination as a horror-novel author with a knack for turning his mundane life into a harrowing ghost story. These spooks live only in his head... that is until he meets Min, a man haunted by the supernatural specters in Chan's novel! With everything around him suddenly turning into an eerie mess, is Chan's growing love for Min the reason why his heart is racing? Or is it the bloody ghost behind him?

name: You Maniac
summary: Handsome, tasteful Dean likes to party and seduce, never wanting to be tied down. However, after accepting a request from his good friend Ten, Dean finds himself doing whatever it takes to win over contradictory artist Moth. You see, Ten wants to pursue Pun, but Pun has feelings for Moth. At first, Dean doesn't give much thought to flirting, but Moth's indifference to him triggers his competitive instinct to win.

name: Winner
summary: Lu Yunxiang, who takes over his late brother's courier business and transforms it into a modern logistics empire. From a small time entrepreneur to a listed company leader, his journey reflects the rise of China's private delivery industry and a generation that dared to dream big.

name: Match Point
summary: Perfect school tennis player Sun and indie, arts-track boy Bay have feuding fathers. Their families own competing dim sum restaurants on Krong Thong Road: Sun's family's old, traditional shop Saming Phon Fai, and Bay's family's Merlion, a new spot famous for its shumai. When Bay enters a tennis tryout to annoy Sun and Sun loses due to an injury, the principal orders a rematch. In turn, their fathers Chun and Bee strike a deal: whichever family loses must close their dim sum business for good. When the day of the match arrives and circumstances push them to take up representing the school as a doubles pair, the two keep it a secret from their fathers. As they train at a resort outside the city and begin to open up to each other, Bay and Sun make their own wager: if they win the men's doubles championship, their fathers must allow them to date; if they lose, however, they'll never see each other again.

name: Weirdo-101
summary: Without realising it, Niran starts getting closer to Cheewa, the school's nerdy student. When he tries to distance himself, he discovers their paths are already completely intertwined.

name: Write You Again
summary: After an accident 10 years ago, Nine lost all his memories. He decides to return to the house where he lived as a child and, once there, he reunites with someone important from his past.

name: Billionaire Biker
summary: O makes a huge mistake when he confuses his future boss for a motorbike taxi driver. He thinks he's in trouble — but ends up becoming his boss's favourite person.

name: Kiss Me, Remember?
summary: Pas, who has lost his memory is saved from drowning through mouth-to-mouth. When he realises that every time he kisses Kit, the guy who saved him, a piece of his memory returns, he suddenly wants to kiss him all the time.

name: My Professional Boyfriend
summary: When the son of a mafia boss needs to find a boyfriend to escape his father's control, he decides to hire someone who will pretend they are in a relationship.

name: Twenty One
summary: When Aii and Koon are heartbroken by the same person, the two take comfort in each other and find they have a lot in common. Given all the time they're spending together, to make things easier, they agree to live together. As their closeness grows, Koon's bandmates attempt to persuade Koon to act on what they sense goes beyond friendship. Afraid of losing what they have but also of losing Aii if he can't return his feelings, Koon proposes a twenty-one day experiment to see if Aii can make him fall for him.

name: Lovers & Gangsters
summary: A young guy falls in love with a rival gangster of his family — the very one responsible for killing his father. Now, his brother won't rest until he ruins his new brother-in-law's life.

name: Good Boy
summary: After living a lonely life and dying in an accident at age thirty, a man is given a second chance to go back in time. He wakes up as a teenager during his school years and decides to live a different life.

name: When Oranges Fall
summary: A school-age love story that begins with an orange—when an orange from the yard of Ko Song falls into the yard of his neighbor and classmate Ko Neung. Despite sharing the same nickname, the two couldn't be more different. An unlikely friendship slowly blossoms into a close bond, with the "oranges" bringing them together. The story also follows the friendship of their group of friends—Augar, Achi, August, and their classmate, Tle—all set against the backdrop of school life in the 90s. How will the oranges lead them to love?

name: Gunshot
summary: After losing the love of his life, Mini begins a journey of revenge against everyone who hurt him. Kongpon, a police officer assigned to his case tries to bring him back to happiness.

name: Greatest Basslines
summary:
Series celebrating music's killer basslines and the glory of the bottom end. Following the same format as Greatest Guitar Riffs and with A-List musical talent at its heart, each episode is authored by a different bass expert, offering three unique perspectives of experience and expertise and allowing the series to traverse through multiple genres: rock, funk, disco & hip hop and reggae & club culture.

Each episode combines newly-shot interviews, immersive experiences and masterclasses from each author alongside exciting archive and new contributions from a range of musicians that speak to the different basslines/tracks covered.

name: Roommate Chaos
summary: Three couples who share dorm rooms find themselves beginning to develop unexpected feelings - A prodigy student who loves to party and the strict dorm supervisor. Two actors who are cast to lead a BL stage play together, and two complete opposites; one is a morning person, the other is a night owl.

name: Plan B to U
summary: With his life savings, Nile purchases a house owned by Art, the CEO of record company Rabbit Hole, for a bargain price. However, it turns out the house is haunted. Nile tries to return the sale, but Art refuses, so Nile comes up with a plan B: land an internship at Rabbit Hole and exact his revenge.

name: 17th Spring
summary: Marn, who was born with HIV, transfers to a new school, where he meets Than, a rebellious student. As they grow closer, they begin to bring out the best in each other.

name: Simon Cowell: The Next Act
summary: Simon Cowell wants to discover the next great boy band. Can he balance the dreams of young hopefuls with the harsh realities of the music industry?

name: How to Survive My CEO
summary: One evening, completely drunk, Pafon kisses a stranger. When he starts his new internship, that stranger turns out to be his boss Phatlom, who, hooked on Pafon's kiss, appoints him as his personal photographer.

name: The Sweet Journey
summary: After her marriage to a cheating CEO falls apart, a determined single mother overcomes poverty by building a successful dessert business with the support of a kind deliveryman, ultimately choosing her hard-won independence and new love over her ex-husband's belated remorse.

name: Cupid's Ghost
summary: Florist Phut is afraid of ghosts and, therefore, funerals. When Phut startles at a ghost in Jett's funeral home, Jett offers him a job communicating with the recently deceased he provides services for.

name: Unlucky Bae
summary: In trying to curse the guy who just dumped him, Rin, a fine arts student and heir to a family of sorcerers, accidentally hits the wrong person. Khobfah, a third-year business administration student, with his spell. While he can't undo the bad luck he's brought about, he'll try to use his own good luck to balance out Khobfah's misfortune.

name: The Invisible Dragon
summary: Khun is a passionate young man eager to become the Lion's Head for the Dragon Festival. But he's also interested in Earn. Earn, on the other hand, is more concerned with summoning the dragon. Being an adopted child, he doesn't have dragon blood flowing in his veins. As they train, Earn and Khun grow closer, but an obstacle stands in their way: Leng.

name: I Will Always Save You
summary: When musician Pepper is forced to enter the witness protection program after witnessing a murder committed by the son of an influential politician, Lieutenant Pongpuen is assigned to protect him. The two have a complicated history involving Pongpuen's ex. Despite clashing, Pongpuen has sworn to protect Pepper from any danger that might threaten him.

name: Arrest and Action
summary: Two argumentative lieutenants are assigned to go undercover in the entertainment industry to investigate a case. But their dynamic causes problems — and now the two of them are forced to film a BL series together so as not to blow their cover.

name: Mr. Kill
summary:
Kaye, a famous manga artist, finds himself under the watchful eye of Phat, the inspector overseeing a serial murder case, after the victims' profiles, killing methods, and crime scenes are found to bear a suspicious resemblance to scenes from Kaye's old work. Thrown together by circumstances, the two must join forces to uncover the truth, solve the case, and track down the killer. Along the way, two strangers slowly find themselves bound by something that feels a lot like trust. 
But the deeper they dig, the more the past resurfaces, and what it reveals beginning to shake their relationship.
As the clues keep unfolding, the bond they've built is put to the test ... leaving them to wonder whether they can push forward together, or they'll end up becoming the killer's next victims.

name: Overdose
summary: The day after her boozy birthday party, Mars wakes up to discover the body of her boyfriend stabbed. Immediately, she becomes the primary suspect: her DNA was found on the murder weapon, a knife used to cut the cake. She proclaims her innocence, but faced with the overwhelming evidence, her lawyer suggests she pleads guilty, while Sand's brother challenges her to find the true culprit if she truly is innocent. Once released, Mars decides to take revenge for the trap that was set on her.

name: Her
summary: On their wedding night, groom Apo catches the bride with her stepfather, Chawin, who attacks Apo to protect their secret. Apo is mutilated and believed to be dead. In order to seek vegeance, Apo becomes a woman and installs herself as Chawin's secretary. In this position, Apo gets to know a member of the family, Porpan, and identifies her as their weakness...or her own.

name: Oxytoxin
summary: The story of a influential high school friend group known as Toxxxxin.

name: The Cross-Dressed Union
summary: Plagued by a realm left defenseless after his predecessor's purges, the new emperor Yan Lin faces crises at home and abroad. To shield the general's son, Nan Chenxiao, who hides in female disguise, and Rui Yu, who serves in court as a man, Yan Lin ordains a marriage between them, seeking a new variable in the desperate situation. Through shared trials and life-and-death journeys, the two uncover each other's secrets, kindle a hidden love, and ultimately help Yan Lin usher in a prosperous age.

name: Love's Echoes
summary: Clara and New shared the same dream: to become idols. Today, one of them shines bright under the spotlight, while the other stays in the shadows, having turned to writing. Their paths cross again when a novel of New's is getting a screen adaptation and Clara discovers the truth behind their estrangement: New gave up because of a tumor deteriorating her hearing. Once very close, will this reunion allow them to revive their bond... or perhaps build something altogether stronger?

name: Enemies with Benefits
summary: Head of Sales Lal is determined to triumph over Head of Accounting Wine. Wine is her polar opposite and known for her mercilessness. When a night of spontaneity leads them to a friends with benefits relationship, they'll do anything to keep it a secret, pretending to be enemies so that absolutely no one at work finds out. Without realising it, however, their newfound closeness begins to give way to love.

name: Moonshadow
summary: After a painful breakup, Jan, the owner of a cozy bar, shuts her heart off from love and focuses solely on surviving in the shadows of her past. Everything changes when Key, a bold young singer, steps into her world after a one-night encounter openly declaring she wants to be Jan's sugar baby. What begins as a purely physical arrangement morphs into something deeper as Key's warmth begins to melt Jan's icy walls. Just as their feelings become undeniable, Jan's ex unexpectedly returns, testing the fragile bond forming between them.

name: Wish Upon a Star
summary: A story of two young women who share the name. After the Dao who shines so bright tragically loses her life, forgotten and lonely Dao travels back in time to high school to save her life. In order to do succeed, she'll have to find the courage to do what she never dared to and stand by her side.

name: Bake Love Feeling
summary: Though we got off to a bad start, I hope that we'll get close and that I'll be able to work smoothly with you. I don't know if it's from proximity or what that's making my heart race. I have to keep telling myself that the kindness you've been showing me is only out of obligation, don't take it so seriously!

name: Ditto
summary: This is the story of two very different women. One is a promising ballerina, rich and arrogant. The other is a well-mannered flight attendant, always ready with a smile. The two share nothing in common...except for a name. Rafah. Somehow, fate joins them together in a fall from heaven—a flight attendant with a fractured wing and a dancer with a broken leg.

name: Обыкновенный фашизм
summary:
Mikhail Romm creates an original montage film using newsreel footage from another country.

The director drew on German archives, collections of photographs confiscated from German soldiers, and the archives of postwar anti-fascist organizations to recount the origins and characteristics of the movement that led to the outbreak of World War II.

The film opens with footage shot by Romm's team specifically for the project in the 1960s. These scenes depict everyday life in Prague, Moscow, and Berlin. This peaceful exposition leads into the main narrative.

The film presents documentary evidence of numerous fascist crimes, accompanied by the director's voice-over narration describing this terrifying movement.

name: Casa-Abrigo
summary: Inspired by true stories, we follow Vera, Madalena, Conceição and Gabriela, victims of domestic violence in a shelter. Together, they rediscover their place, while trying to gain independence and security to start a new life. Each episode is dedicated to one of the women and also to Joana, the psychologist who accompanies them. A personal sharing and a unique testimony from women who are not defined by the dramatic situation they find themselves in, without ever being able to forget it.

name: Past, Present, Perfect?
summary: In high school, Shantal (2003) experienced the pangs of first love after she met Sir Daniel, her Filipino teacher. Fast forward to the present, Shantal (2018) now pursuing a career in writing, gets the biggest surprise of her life as she crosses paths with Sir Daniel once again in their high school reunion. Has the time already come for Shantal's unrequited love to be reciprocated by the man she admires the most? Will the perfect love she dreamt of ever come true?

name: Sins of the Father
summary: A self-made man has spent his life building an honest name, desperate to escape his estranged father's criminal legacy. Now, falsely implicated in his father's sins, he must fight to prove his innocence before they destroy everything he holds dear.

name: Love at First Spike
summary: A former basketball team captain finds himself in a tough situation as he is forced to join the school's boys' volleyball varsity team composed of queer members.

name: Let Me Into Your Heart
summary: Two performers from different fields have to come together to collaborate on a new series, "A Playful Kiss in Likay Style," with likay hero Ja helping lead man Jack prepare for his role. On the outside, everything appears to flow seamlessly, but behind the scenes, the two are clashing like mad.

name: Вечерняя школа
summary: Dimon, an officer of the patrol and guard service, is forced to sit down at his desk again in order to receive a secondary education certificate and retain his position. People of all ages and backgrounds come to night school with him for various reasons. Here they relive familiar school situations: the first two, the first fight and, of course, the first kiss. They will hear the phrase "didn't you forget your head at home?" again, they will find themselves in the Kamchatka classroom, close their mouths and open their notebooks.

name: The Sparrow's Gambit
summary: After being betrayed by her adoptive father, the formidable and beautiful assassin Qingmao is left for dead. In her final moments, she uncovers the truth that the mastermind behind her family's annihilation has been lurking nearby. Burning with vengeance, she bides her time for five years, reinventing herself as the enchanting songstress Liu Rumeng. Now, under this new identity, she sets her revenge plan in motion...

name: One Night In Lincoln
summary: The multi-talented Mike Harding entertains an audience at the Theatre Royal, Lincoln, with his one-man show.

previousepisode.name: It's Hard to be an Angel When You're 65

name: Shall We Dance
summary: As children, Crown Prince Chu Ying forms an unexpected friendship with the young eunuch Xiao Man, and the two grow up inseparable. When the late emperor passes away, Chu Ying ascends the throne, while Xiao Man is driven out of the palace. Ten years later, Xiao Man returns in disguise, posing as a man. Though they appear close on the surface, both keep their guard up, quietly testing one another. After enduring court intrigue side by side, their relationship begins to shift, and feelings long buried slowly come to light...

name: The Princess Decree
summary: A revenge born of a political marriage reunites the Grand Princess with her former lover at court. Love and rivalry entwine, yet in the end, they discover that only each other can save them. Hand in hand, they play the empire like a chessboard, crafting an age of splendor together.

name: Glory in Shadows
summary: Forced to marry the "deceased" General Li Jingchuan, Shen Yaochu discovers he faked his death. After her mother died under suspicious circumstances, she vows to uncover the truth. Starting as mutual users, they gradually become inseparable allies. In the Li Mansion, they battle the hostess, solve mysteries and investigate murders. Finally, they expose long-hidden conspiracies and find true love.

name: Holy Light
summary: This series follows the journey of intellectual Yi Gaoyuan and the innocent Xizang girl Gesang Meiduo, who meet and connect in Xizang. Their bond deepens into love at Xizang Public School. Centering on their story, the drama portrays the founding and development of Xizang Public School, the first institution of higher learning established by the Communist Party of China in inland China for Xizang. It highlights the tremendous changes brought by the peaceful liberation to Xizang and its people, and depicts the challenging yet steadfast path of New Xizang's progress.

name: Hunting for Crime · Red Deep Grudge
summary: A string of bizarre deaths rocks the Lin Mansion. Madam Lin, a maid, and others are found dead. Each scene is marked by a mysterious scarlet opera robe. Rumors of a "curse from the costume" spread like wildfire. Detective Huang Jinrong, joined by forensic experts Li Chuncheng and Duan Qingqing, digs into the case. They unravel not only the injustice suffered by Bai Mei, the woman behind the robe, but also the Lin family's hidden affairs, corruption, and a long-buried truth of revenge.

name: Shen Xian Dao Zhi Yuan Jian Qing Shan
Secret By My Name
summary: Tan Jianfei, the newly appointed CEO of the Tan Group, is drawn into a dangerous crisis. His former lover Li Shujing suddenly enters the company and challenges him in a ruthless struggle for power. As they clash again and again, old feelings quietly reignite. Unbeknownst to him, Li Shujing has returned as a seeker of truth, determined to uncover the cause of her father's death. When the truth finally emerges, what remains between them is a legacy of family feuds and a carefully laid trap disguised as love.

name: The Architect
summary: On the night of her wedding, Shen Changning, the daughter of a shipping magnate was slaughtered along with her entire family and thrown into the river. Yet she miraculously awakens in a new life, reborn as Xiyan, a dancer in the residence of the powerful Governor Pei Yu. Carrying the weight of blood-deep vengeance, she uses beauty as bait and wit as a shield, advancing step by step. Together with Pei Yu, whose influence spans the entire court, she joins hands to maneuver through a deadly game of revenge. In this high-stakes struggle where every move decides life or death, they vow to reclaim her destiny and the justice that was stolen from her.

name: LuBan Mysteries
summary: During the Republic of China era, the populace was steeped in ignorance and superstition. Li Mudun, the finest carpenter in Fog City, is a master of the ancient text The Secret Manual of LuBan. It is said this manual is divided into two volumes: the first studies woodworking techniques, while the second contains mysterious and unfathomable occult arts. When brides vanish under mysterious circumstances, public suspicion falls on him. To clear his name, Li partners with detective Yang Zong and forensic expert Su Qingyun. Their investigation unveils murders staged with intricate "mechanical traps," leading them through a series of bizarre cases, from the ritual foundation sacrifice, the murderous puppet case, and the rickshaw puller case, all mysteriously linked to Li's estranged brother, Wu Xian. As the city descends into chaos following the death of a military governor, the trio must outwit Wu Xian in a final confrontation. Through their quest, they champion truth over ignorance, upholding the pragmatic spirit and rich heritage at the heart of Chinese tradition.

name: Ancient Bracelet
summary: Zhao, a healer of the Wuyue tribe, is unaware of her divine heritage as a descendant of the goddess. She serendipitously meets and falls for Ying Du, the ruler of the Puluo State, only to witness his merciless slaughter of her people and loved ones. Through the mystical Fengwu Bracelet, which grants the power to traverse time, the two embark on a journey across three reincarnations. Zhao ultimately unravels the truth, defies the heavenly decree that forbids the goddess from love, and shatters the chains of destiny to unite with Yingdu at last.

name: Once More Love in 1995
summary: A modern young woman, Zhuang Manying, is sent back to 1995. Determined to rewrite her mother's tragic fate, she uses her future knowledge to rise fast in the workplace and decisively cut ties with a toxic relationship. What she does not expect is to become entangled in a complicated romance with her cool and reserved uncle, turning her plan to change the past into something far more personal.

name: Rüya Gibi
summary: While working as a hairdresser in an Istanbul suburb, Aydan finds herself the owner of a luxury beauty salon. Her shadowy new boss is Emir, a mysterious businessman about whom no one knows anything. As Aydan struggles to adapt to Emir's world, she's also forced to contend with the troubles caused by her reluctant partner, Çiğdem, a vagrant who grew up in an orphanage. Efe, the reckless police officer who follows Emir, inevitably crosses paths with Çiğdem and the hairdresser. Amidst all this chaos, Aydan seeks solace in her dear friend, manicurist Fiko, while her ex-husband, talented hairdresser Tarık, who can't stomach Aydan's new world of luxury, finds himself facing a new problem every day.

name: Sandi's Great Riviera Rail Trip
summary: Join Sandi Toksvig as she takes a tour of iconic locations on the French coast, discovering the stories of monarchs, artists, and celebrities who transformed the region into a prestigious holiday destination.

name: His Chosen Favor
summary: After graduating, Lu Zhen'er is transmigrated into a "burial concubine" destined for sacrifice. She discovers, by chance, that the puppet emperor, Xiao Wenjing, is actually from her hometown. Refusing to succumb to her perilous fate, she vows to defy heaven and rewrite her destiny, only to find that Xiao Wenjing himself is the one scripting her story...

name: Ni Ting Qi Lai Hen Mei
Immortalis
summary: Three "unique heroes" with opposing backgrounds and hidden identities team up to uncover the secrets of immortality. However, all the bizarre events are interconnected, pointing to a common conspiracy. Working together, the trio quell disaster and break free from the shackles of their respective destinies.

name: Live From Abbey Road: The Very Best Of
summary: Series showcasing performances at the studio from over the years with performances from legendary artists.

previousepisode.name: Paul Simon, David Gilmour, Sheryl Crow

name: Sean Combs: The Reckoning
summary: With unprecedented access in the days before his 2024 arrest, this documentary series thoroughly examines the rise and fall of Sean "Diddy" Combs.

name: Star Search
summary: Star Search is back! The talent is bigger, the stakes are higher, and the format is more interactive than ever. Each episode will spotlight the best up-and-coming performers across four categories – music, dance, variety/comedy, kids – as they compete for their shot at stardom. With an arced competition structure and weekly eliminations, the series builds dramatic momentum, making every live episode an unmissable event.

name: Star Search
summary:
Star Search "The World's Greatest Talent Competition"

Host Ed McMahon and two top name guest stars each week introduce the competition to find the best new stars in eight different performing categories. 1.5 million dollars in cash prizes will be awarded.

name: There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her
summary: Reincarnated as a mid-tier demon, Youki had one job: Crush the hero's party. Then he saw the party's priestess, Cecilia, and fell for her hard. Now this lovestruck demon vows to confess his feelings, even if it means betraying the Demon King. Will love bloom between these two sworn enemies?

previousepisode.name: I Tried Being in a... with My Crush

name: Tak For Ingenting
summary: When two spoiled billionaire heirs have their privileges taken away, a cozy week with their Norwegian stepsister turns into a toxic showdown about love and control.

name: María Isabel
summary: María Isabel is a beautiful and innocent Huichol indigenous woman who lives in a town in the state of Nayarit with her 'tata', Pedro, and with Chona, her stepmother, who has always hated and mistreated her.

name: Las vías del Amor
summary: Perla, a beautiful young woman from the provinces, lives under the unhealthy harassment of Don Jerónimo, the owner of the restaurant where she works; and who, after the murder of her fiancé, takes advantage of the situation to blackmail her, forcing her to marry him.

name: Black Moth
summary: Fourteen-year-old Alice Evergreen returns with her parents to the city of Cascadia after many years of moving. She's certain she won't find any friends here either, but she's wrong: on her very first day, Alice meets teenagers who turn out to be the Guardians of the Forest—defenders of nature and people from the villain Oreso, who has sworn to destroy humanity. Unexpectedly, Alice discovers that she harbors the power of the Black Moth—the missing piece of the Guardians' team. Her voice is not just a talent, but a superpower capable of connecting with the Soul of the Forest and restoring its strength.

name: The Marvellous Miniature Workshop
summary: It's the little things that mean the most. Sara Cox and a team of magnificent makers bring cherished memories back to life. The models may be tiny, but the joy they bring is huge.

name: Mi Verdad Oculta
summary: A strong-willed woman seeks revenge on those who wronged her in her youth, never imagining that love would surprise her on her path to vengeance. Discover Aitana's story.

name: La Venganza
summary: Twenty-five years after enduring one of the biggest tragedies of her life, Helena Fontana is ready to move on to the next chapter and marry Luis Miguel Ariza. Unfortunately, her envious sister tries to strip away her happiness by pretending Luis Miguel is cheating on her, causing Helena to have a heart attack. Death does not stop Helena, and her spirit finds its way into the body of Valentina Díaz, the body she will use to carry out her revenge against everyone who betrayed her and caused her death.

name: Hem Till Skidsverige
summary: How is the ski nation Sweden really doing? Johanna Ojala and Ludvig Svan embark on a journey to seek answers – and meet profiles such as Gunde Svan, Thomas Wassberg & Ebba Andersson.

name: CD:UK
summary: Chart magazine with live bands, videos and occasional celebrity interviews.Chart magazine with live bands, videos and occasional celebrity interviews.

name: Moon: Nature's Secret Force
summary: Series examining the effect of the Moon on life on Earth.

name: A Ship Through Time: Secrets of the Newport Ship
summary: For over 500 years, the Welsh city of Newport was concealing a unique time capsule; an incredibly well-preserved 15th Century shipwreck. Following an international team of experts, Sean Fletcher investigates the secrets of this medieval trading galleon found by accident in 2002, her international significance and how two of Europe's most turbulent and violent wars shaped her fate. On Sean's mission, he discovers what this trading galleon carried, and to where and a possible powerful owner. He also sheds light on a possible connection to the Wars of the Roses.

name: Pogány Induló
summary: Marci, a teen from rural Hungary, becomes a musical sensation known as Pogány Induló. Fame hits fast - but can he handle the intense pace and growing number of personal and professional challenges?

name: Hinahanap-hanap Kita
summary: Helen's husband suddenly stops communicating with her but continues to send support to his family. Helen then decides to go to Dubai to look for her husband, finding support and help from her friends Joy, Lawrence, Margot, Homer, and Reggie who are working in Dubai. The group's journey in searching for Helen's missing husband also serves as a journey to self-discovery, acceptance, and freedom from the personal burdens that they carry in their hearts.

name: Ampalaya Chronicles
summary: An anthology of different narratives of hugot-inspired shorts that mirrors our experiences with falling in love.

name: Krychowiak: krok od szczytu
summary: "Krychowiak: One Step from the Top" isn't a football documentary. It's pure entertainment, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in the world of Grzegorz Krychowiak and his wife, French model and bodybuilder Celia Jaunat. Renowned for his sense of humor and passion for fashion, the athlete has made 100 appearances for the Polish national team. However, for Krychowiak, a football career was just one of many dreams he boldly pursued, never looking back and living life to the fullest. In this documentary, dedicated to his life with Celia, the camera follows him as he pursues his goals, both professional and personal.

name: Science of Sound
summary: Music educator and pro musician Marty Schwartz talks with experts about the science of how music affects our emotions, brains, and bodies.

name: My Name Is ...
summary: A talent show founded by the Dutch television host, Albert Verlinde

name: Rock Nation
summary: Rock Nation, a program in which Edwin Jansen and Dennis Weening wanted to form a rock band with twenty musicians.

name: 24 uur met...
summary: 24 uur met... is a Dutch talkshow where the host stays for 24 hours with a guest in a small one-room studio. During these 24 hours they can't leave the studio.

name: Put Up Or Shut Up
summary: Brian Lohnes heads to dragstrips, off-road courses, road circuits and beyond to show you some of the most interesting motorsports on earth. He sets up match races where he compels racers to let it all hang out for a $10,000 prize.

name: Guerra de mujeres
summary: A young woman, Yubirí, seeks success in her career and in love. A fortune teller tells her that she will meet her beloved; that same night she meets Wilker, a young singer, and Juan Diego.

name: El amor las vuelve locas
summary:
A broken love, suspended in time. Deep secrets hidden and a colossal lie engulfing them all. Fernanda has been married for twenty years to a man who has made her unhappy. But Pablo, her great love from her youth, whom she believes to be dead, is alive. He has spent twenty years in a hell behind bars, accused of a terrible crime.

This is a contemporary story, a story of love fraught with impossibilities, a story of a truth that has always been hidden. It's the story of any woman in love, because when you love... love drives you mad.

name: The Lost World of Communism
summary:
Documentary series on the fall of the Iron Curtain and its legacy.

1989 marked the collapse of communism in Eastern and Central Europe and an end to a way of life for millions of people. Having lived through extraordinary times, they tell their stories of life behind the Iron Curtain, looking beyond the headlines of spies and surveillance, secret police and political repression, to reveal a rich tapestry of experience.

name: Shining Inheritance
summary: The story of the series will revolve around three families–the Villarazon, De La Costa, and Abrigo– and who is worthy of being the heir to Aurea De La Costa's company.

name: Romántica Obsesión
summary: Alejandro falls in love with Mariana, but he doesn't know how to approach her, so he starts sending her love letters. Mariana immediately falls for a mysterious author of romantic letters. The only person who knows the real author of those letters is Oscar, Alejandro's best friend, who takes advantage of the situation and wins Mariana over behind Alejandro's back, telling her that he was the one who sent the letters. Mariana is confused, since something about Oscar's personality tells her he couldn't have written those letters. And Alejandro still doesn't have the courage to confess the truth.

name: Estado de fuga 1986
summary: An army veteran lures a young student into a dark, twisted friendship in this chilling drama about a massacre in '80s Bogotá, inspired by real events.

name: The Twist
summary: The award-winning animated series that brings to life some of Australia's most intriguing crime stories. These were crimes of passion, old-fashioned gangland homicides and mysteries that captivated the entire nation.

name: Gardiens de la forêt
summary: At the heart of five primary forests, from the Amazon to Oceania via Africa, five representatives of indigenous communities are committed to protecting these green lungs: reforesting, fighting pollution, preserving biodiversity. Through their sensitive gaze, this documentary series invites us to rediscover their vision of the world.

previousepisode.name: Mongolie, le sanctuaire de la taïga

name: The Nowhere Man
summary: Lukas, a former mercenary haunted by PTSD, roams the city as a waste picker with his trolley. At the homeless shelter where he lives, he salvages scraps to help others. Using his metalworking skill, he crafts statues and sells them to raise funds, quietly battling the violent past he longs to escape.

name: Silencio
summary: In the shadows of history, a secret beats like a pulse. Two vampire sisters survive a shortage of "clean human blood" during the Black Death, but the true poison is the silence that surrounds them. Centuries later, one of their descendants faces the same conflict during the AIDS pandemic in Spain and discovers that social condemnation has not changed. Love between the "sick" and the "healthy," between humans and vampires, still inspires the same terror. What happens when eternity is measured in centuries of silence?

name: Red Photon Zillion
summary: The story takes place on the planet Maris in the year 2387. Around this time, the Nozas started to genocidally kill all humans in order to lay eggs and reproduce on the planet. Three mysterious guns dubbed the "Zillion Weapon System" appear and three teens (JJ, Champ, and Apple) are chosen to wield them as the White Knights in order to fight back against the Nozas.

name: Genesis
summary: Teen prodigy Lin Dongfeng and wealthy heiress Zheng Wanzhi are a campus couple trying to avoid the cliché of breaking up after graduation. At the same time, Lin receives an unexpected invitation from Gu Binqing, head of domestic tech giant Huasheng Group. While he hesitates, a comment he posts online about controlled nuclear fusion draws intense national and international attention. Renowned physicist Wu Wenyong recognizes Lin's extraordinary talent, and under the leadership of Minister Yang Zhengdao, a "Chasing the Sun" task force is formed, with Lin appointed as its lead. As they push through multiple phases of fusion research, Lin faces mounting challenges—from rivals attempting to steal breakthroughs, to emotional dilemmas, to internal scrutiny and political pressure—testing both his scientific vision and his resolve.

name: The Mirage
summary: Mysterious mirages frequently appear above Dengzhou City. Zeng Qian, a female bounty hunter escorting a prisoner with her younger brother Zeng Xin, is unexpectedly drawn into a dangerous upheaval after tearing down the wanted poster of the vigilante thief known as Nightshade. As strange incidents plague the city—civilians vanish without explanation, mirages descend to the ground only to rise again, and an iron-armored giant suddenly emerges—Zeng Xin goes missing. In her search for him, Zeng Qian is forced to form an uneasy alliance with Cao Sheng, a brilliant strategist; Nightshade, whose true identity remains a mystery; and Xie Jingtang, an arrogant yet highly skilled warrior. As the group works together, they dismantle misunderstandings and pursue the truth behind the mirages. Caught between kinship, friendship, and a greater moral cause, they must confront unknown forces and uncover the fantastical conspiracy surrounding the illusory city in the sky.

name: De Jeugdkliniek: Als Niets Meer Werkt
What's The Monarchy For?
summary: Power, money and influence - the monarchy is at the heart of our national life. David Dimbleby takes a personal look at its role and its future in a changing world.

name: The Sycamore Gap Tree Mystery
summary: Inside the police hunt to solve the mystery of the destruction of the Sycamore Gap tree in September 2023 - a crime of extraordinary vandalism that shocked Britain.

name: Classic Christmas Movies
summary: Film critic Ian Nathan presents a series exploring some of our perennial Christmas favourites. Each episode will tell the story of a single film, delving into the trials and triumphs behind it and identifying the ingredients that elevated it from a simple movie to a classic.

name: No Tail to Tell
summary: Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a football player -- altering both of their fates.

name: A Happy Place
summary: Vered is in a 40-year-old crisis - her marriage is boring, work is boring and the house is suffocating. One evening Naomi, her aging mother, declares that she has lost the purpose of life and asks Vered to kill her. Vered does not agree and goes on a wild journey in order to find meaning in both of their lives.

name: Safe Space
summary: An underqualified Dr. Fredericks does his best to help and therapize struggling couples back to a so-called "safe space."

name: Gokudo
summary: Gokudo is an adventurer, all he wants is to have all the hot girls and money in the world. However, he soon learns from a old hag that a evil king is trying to hurt him, he sets out on a series of crazy and wild adventures.

previousepisode.name: See Ya, Everybody! Nobody Can Stop Me Now!

name: БЭКПЕКЕРЫ
summary:
"BACKPACKERS" is the first Zoomer travel show!

Eight top bloggers - Amina Tenderlybae, Lesha Younger, Sabina Khairova, Andrey Kokoshka, Katya Adushkina, Dilblin, Dinara Kurbanova and Narek Simonyan will show the coolest places on the planet, and most importantly, they will prove that you can travel with only one backpack and a minimum account balance.

The task of the guys is to complete challenges, get money for them, which can be spent on food, lodging or entertainment, and save as much as possible. Whoever has less cash left in the finals will have to experience the main "nightmare of the city".

previousepisode.name: БЭКПЕКЕРЫ на Пхукете | Андрей Кокошка и Дилблин vs Сабина Хайрова и Катя Адушкина

name: СРЕДИ НАС
summary:
Among Us is a show in which adults try to get lost among children!

So that they have at least some chance, all the voices are changed, and the children's eyes are closed. In this issue, Ivan Abramov and Ekaterina Morgunova will try to get into a children's party. Will they be able to, or will they fall for the obvious?

name: Shinyuu no "Dousei shite" ni "Un" to Iu made
summary: Meet Wataru, an open book who wears his heart on his sleeve, and Minato, a man who always comes across as cool, calm, and collected. Though they're polar opposites, their shared love of photography brings them together in high school, and they become such good friends that they decide to rent a place together in college. It's only when Minato moves across the country for work after graduation that Wataru realizes he's been harboring romantic feelings for the stoic gentleman this whole time. So when they reunite three years later, Wataru hopes they'll be able to reconnect as friends... but now it's Minato who seems to have his sights set on romance! Friends or lovers - which will they choose? The countdown to their final decision is on!

name: Goedemorgen Nederland
summary: Morning show in which two presenters discuss current affairs with various guests, focusing on politics, economics, security, and Dutch identity.

name: Dunkman
summary: Dunkman with 40 of the top dunkers from around the world competing for a $200,000 prize.

name: Jin Ri Bu Yi Zha Pian Shen Ming
Provocative Love
summary: Betrayed by her fiancé at the engagement party, Jiang Nan enters into a marriage of convenience with her ex-boyfriend Fu Jinchuan to jointly fight for the family fortune against the schemes of her cousin Jiang Bei and the Huo family. Through battles over company shares, the murder of her father, and kidnapping crises, she recognizes Jinchuan's deep affection amid their intense push and pull. Ultimately, they expose the mastermind behind the scenes, inherit the Jiang Group, and find true love in each other.

name: Love by Force
summary: The daughter of a duke, Wenren Ya, falls in love at first sight with the top scorer Lu Chen and pursues him passionately to marry into her family. Lu Chen appears cold but hides a mysterious past, staying in the capital to investigate his adoptive mother's death and royal secrets. To get closer to him, Wenren Ya enters the Nanyong Academy and repeatedly helps Lu Chen when he is framed by the Su family. Their bond grows amidst crises. Though Lu Chen pushes her away due to his vendetta, Wenren Ya stands by him, aiding in uncovering the truth. Eventually, Lu Chen discovers he is a swapped royal heir and, with Wenren Ya, exposes the Su family's plot. He renounces his royal status to marry into Wenren's household. On their wedding day, Su Yingjie causes trouble again but is subdued by Wenren Ya. The story ends with the couple united, looking forward to a bright future together.

name: Zui Hao Bu Yao Xi Huan Wo
Fu Gui Bi Ren Zhi Chuan Cheng Tai Nai Bao You Wo
Hide One's Beloved in a Secluded Place
Why is This Happening? with Chris Hayes
summary: Chris Hayes asks the big questions that keep him up at night. How do we make sense of this unprecedented moment in world history? Why is this (all) happening?

previousepisode.name: The ‘Hellish Cauldron' of American Politics with Alex Wagner

name: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
summary: A look at Earth's most captivating bodies of water.

name: Jamie's Cook-Ahead Christmas
summary: Jamie Oliver brings us the Christmas 2025 culinary countdown guaranteed to get us all organised for the most stress-free festive feast ever. No Christmas cooks will be left behind in the kitchen while festive fun is being had, as Jamie shows us how to cook ahead of time in the weeks leading up to the big day - the perfect present to ourselves and others!

name: Twisted Sisters: Madness & Manslaughter
summary: Two-part documentary exploring one of the strangest cases in modern British history In May 2008.

name: Don't Open the Door
summary:
Don't Open the Door tells chilling true-crime tales of unsuspecting individuals whose lives are forever altered when a stranger knocks on the door.

In a world where danger lurks just beyond the threshold, ordinary people are thrust into nightmares when their unexpected guests reveal malevolent motives.

A suburban couple's act of kindness towards a storm-soaked stranger leads to a costly scam. A single mother's trust in a supposed delivery person turns into a hostage situation. A woman's door-to-door evangelism covers up a sinister cult recruitment scheme.

name: Troy Story
summary:
Troy Story explores the latest archaeology and science on one of history's most enduring mysteries: did the Trojan War really happen?

In 1874 Heinrich Schliemann announced he had found the legendary city of Troy and caused a sensation. His discoveries have been challenged, and yet ushered in a golden age of archaeology. More than 150 years later, what can we now say is the truth behind the myth?

name: A Very British Christmas
summary: Some very special stately homes and two of Britain's top designers come together for some very special Christmas celebrations.

name: Aoshi Dan Shen
summary: Born with a disability, and taking a desperate gamble, Shen Xiang ventures into perilous lands to find medicine to open his spiritual meridians. He unexpectedly saves two injured goddesses, one divine and one demonic, awakening his own divine meridians. Protecting his father and family, he becomes a legendary alchemist.

name: Fushou Akiyama Yukari no Sensha Kouza
summary:
A series of bonus videos for the anime Girls und Panzer. These are short videos included as special content on Blu-ray/DVD discs, with one video per Blu-ray/DVD volume, and a total of six videos released, similar to the Blu-ray/DVD releases. The side stories, including the bonus videos, have also been released on other Girls und Panzer related Blu-rays and DVDs, and production of bonus videos continues even after the final chapter.

This is a series in which Yukari Akiyama, a loader from Team Angler, appears as the main character, and Yukari explains the tanks in the series, tank-related terminology and equipment, and the actual history of their use. Various visual materials to aid understanding and scenes featuring tanks in the play appear like replays.

name: Mosquito
summary: Kate and Ed are a recently married couple whose secrets begin to unravel as life chips away at the personas they present. The kicker? The couple's unraveling starts with an intrusive mosquito.

name: Yekumot
summary: Fluctuating between sanity and nonsense, highs and lows, clever and idiotic – Roi Kafri finally makes it to television with a grown up series in which he plays a host of characters in different stories and worlds, overflowing with emotion, an absurd ensemble cast, and a plot that makes even less sense.

name: Dad tries his best
summary: Yossi Weiss, a recently fired tour guide who, after years of being absent from home, tries to reconnect with his family, especially his daughter Dana, who has special needs.

name: Champignon Witch
summary:
Deep in the Black Forest, a witch named Luna lived quietly in a house of poisonous mushrooms.

Poisonous mushrooms often grew wherever she touched or walked, and her breath and skin were laced with poison. The townspeople called her the "Champignon Witch." Feared as a black witch, no one approached her.

Luna continued to travel to town today to sell her medicines. Her medicines were highly sought after as a panacea, and everyone who bought one unanimously expressed their gratitude. However, no one knew who made them. But Luna continued to make them.

One day, Luna, a lonely woman who had never experienced human warmth, had a dreamlike encounter...

A magical fantasy of love, adventure, and emotion begins now!

This is a love story between the kind-hearted dark witch Luna and the people around her.

name: Legacy of Spies
summary: The series begins in the shadow of the newly-erected Berlin Wall, as Alec Leamas watches his last agent shot dead by East German sentries. For Leamas, a senior British intelligence officer in Berlin, the Cold War is over. As he faces the prospect of retirement or worse - a desk job - Control offers him a unique opportunity for revenge. Assuming the guise of an embittered and dissolute ex-agent, Leamas is set up to trap Mundt, the deputy director of the East German Intelligence Service, with himself as the bait. In the background is George Smiley, ready to make the game play out just as Control wants.
